label: Dharwad peda
note: Karnataka; GI tag number 80; about 175 years old; milk heated and stirred continuously with sugar; started by the Thakur family who came from Unnao

about.text: A peda from Dharwad in Karnataka, made from the milk of Dharwadi buffaloes heated and stirred continuously with sugar; it has GI tag number 80.
